description: This file is a Markdown documentation source for the 'Coverage' class in the Playwright API, providing details about code coverage features for JavaScript and CSS, including methods to start and stop coverage collection, options, and usage notes.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: A class providing APIs to collect JavaScript and CSS coverage data for web pages.

methods.name: Coverage.startCSSCoverage.resetOnNavigation
methods.description: Option to reset coverage on each navigation, defaults to true.

methods.name: Coverage.startJSCoverage.resetOnNavigation
methods.description: Option to reset JavaScript coverage on each navigation, defaults to true.

methods.name: Coverage.startJSCoverage.reportAnonymousScripts
methods.description: Option to report anonymous scripts such as eval or dynamically created scripts, defaults to false.

methods.name: Coverage.stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and returns coverage details.

methods.name: Coverage.stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and returns coverage details.
